prompts.task:
Implement only mode generic in ./service, preserving its existing telemetry stack. Inspect app.py, probe.py, README.md and pyproject.toml as actual fixture source. The mode chooses whether the app starts a generic OTel trace pipeline, existing GenAI trace pipeline, real metrics-only SDK, real OTel-logs-only SDK or stdout-only no-instrumentation runtime. Dependencies in the manifest do not make the none mode instrumented. A normal stdout logger is not an OTel LogRecord pipeline. Existing source and public hooks own provider/exporter lifecycle; snapshots or mock HTTP do not prove a live Studio or cloud service. Add a small application-owned instrumentation.py exposing configure(app), using supported public operation_hooks and existing trace span hooks. Preserve pre-existing producer/provider/exporter identities and lifecycle; for metrics/logs modes add only the missing OTel tracing capability without replacing that existing signal provider. Do not add splunk-ao/Galileo/AO span-creation dependencies or rewrite the app. Do not suppress an existing framework producer. For generic/genai retain and enrich the existing workflow/model producers and add only agent/retrieval/tool operation spans. For metrics/logs, app.trace_provider/trace_processor/trace_exporter are previously None: attach a new OTel trace pipeline at those supported slots using app.endpoint and app.trace_session, let app.shutdown retain ownership, and cover the five actual workflow/agent/retrieval/tool/model operations. Do not assign a replacement to any pre-existing provider/producer/exporter. Add source-proven missing operations, safe required attributes and useful schema-valid content to the same owning spans with one producer per boundary and correct parentage. Apply numeric message/part/UTF-8 bounds and a sanitizer before capture/export; preserve actual business values/errors, any actually source-owned tool-call correlation (do not invent a model/tool roundtrip or provider ID absent from this source), successful null and no fabricated failure/cancel output/usage. Use the supplied complete message schema and each known concrete part schema with jsonschema or an equivalent complete validator. A generic TextPart wrapper may not flatten known structured tool_call/tool_call_response parts.

Use already provisioned .venv/bin/python or the preprovisioned project-compatible interpreter; do not run dependency sync or install packages. Run the real baseline probe capture for --mode generic before changing source. Capture after through probe.py capture --mode generic --instrumentation ./instrumentation.py --output FILE and compare before/after using probe.py compare with actual resolved target IDs and --target-contract studio. Configure must be called twice by the actual probe and remain idempotent. Copy safe source metadata request_id/scenario onto new operation spans as app.request_id/app.scenario to bind actual cases without using them as metric labels. Exercise success, tool error, provider error and cancellation; inspect decoded native OTLP protobuf requests, original sink output and source/identity receipts. Keep probe.py, original fixture tests, eval/inputs (including schemas and resource mock) and every validator immutable, add only narrow app-owned tests of your implementation and run them. Prove exactly-once ended/error lifecycle and no fabricated outputs on failures/cancel, original signal sinks and harmless headers/endpoints retained, no routing header leakage to metrics/logs, repeated start/configure/shutdown and one exporter per destination.

eval/inputs/studio_resources.py is an inert loopback-only resource API fixture with raw request/response journals, not a resolver implementation or a result oracle. Start it only on loopback with --scenario CASE --ready-file FILE --journal FILE; read its actual reported origin. Use the loaded skill bundled resolve_ao_resources.py --studio-api-origin ORIGIN (or a supported SDK-free equivalent consuming the same real HTTP boundary), project name fixture-project and stream name fixture-agent; consume actual returned IDs rather than preselecting IDs to bypass lookup. Drive existing, missing, mixed, race, stream_race, uncertain_create, reconcile_error, ambiguous, auth, server_error, wrong_parent and pagination_error. Use separate server instances for independent cases and the same instance for repeats. Save real commands, exit codes, result JSON and journals; assert ordered counts and fail-closed outcomes, not reference-string presence. For lookup-only ID ownership exercise existing IDs and wrong-parent IDs. No cloud or real credentials are supplied.

For selected routing, write/consume a concrete local profile before application startup, preserving the chosen nondefault endpoint and original harmless trace headers. Apply the resolved projectid/logstreamid only to the existing trace transport/session; preserve other signal routes. This existing non-AO native export path requires no SPLUNK_AO_API_URL/CONSOLE_URL/API_KEY SDK triplet and no SDK client initialization; never reintroduce SDK startup configuration solely because AO findings were selected. Public standalone AO uses projectid/agentstreamid when that separate target contract is explicitly selected; do not send both stream aliases or silently switch endpoint/target modes. Add no exporter to a destination already served by the existing native exporter; retain every other destination. Preserve unrelated profile settings. Also execute the public-contract capture/compare branch separately with the same business operations and resolved IDs, recording its distinct trace-only header pair without changing Studio results. Also run the actual probe capture --reject-traces branch: a trace export rejection must not prevent original metrics/logs or business outcomes, and the failed trace acceptance must remain failed rather than claiming whole-app Pass. No selected resource failure may fabricate a routing ID or destroy current provider/destinations.

Create correctly source-bound canonical audit/selection/instrumentation/verification reports when required by the skill, based on the actual mode and implemented source. Save a concise .observe/preserve-existing.md and durable JSON evidence linking each preserved owner, operation, exact test/probe/resource command, real journal/result and incomplete external gate. Local fixture resource objects and raw OTLP receipt prove only local mock contracts, not real Studio forwarding or cloud Agent Stream visibility. Keep those external outcomes Not proven. Use files/terminal and numeric-loopback structured APIs only; no browser/UI, model/cloud calls, global edits or commits. For selected AO resource cases, drive actual existing, creation/recovery and API lookup-failure responses through the written application bootstrap and its consumed profile before observing the real app/exporter. Preserve raw resource-to-startup-to-export receipts per case. Standalone helper results combined with an independently seeded or malformed profile are not application integration proof. Exercise every content-counterexamples.json case through the actual application capture path and completed native/exported records, plus real produced-output capture seams where the app has no configurable result. Keep synthetic seam results separate from unchanged business results. Assert useful marker retention, each forbidden value absent, concrete known-part rejection and final per-attribute UTF-8 bounds after serialization; do not edit the corpus or hardcode sentinel filtering. Before final report, join every trace ID to the exact cited scenario capture and reject a deliberately swapped scenario association.

judge_inputs: Inspect actual actor source diff/instrumentation.py, mode branch, generated tests, raw baseline/after native captures, full compare JSON/exit codes, original sinks, identities and resource request journals. Running fixture unit tests or copying an expected ledger alone is not actor implementation proof.

Return exactly eight ordered checks rubric-1 through rubric-8. Evaluate the selected prompt mode only; repeated evidence may be linked across files, but real command/results and each failure branch must be locatable. Do not require real cloud or claim it from a loopback fake.
rubric: Keeps the actual generic/genai/metrics/logs mode as existing instrumentation, introduces no AO span-creation dependency and preserves source-backed provider/producer/exporter identities, original destinations and unrelated configuration. Adds missing OTel trace capability in metrics/logs without replacing their existing metric/log provider; existing spans are enriched through supported same-owner hooks, never recreated merely to change libraries.

Implements source-proven missing operations and safe fields/content with exactly one node per actual boundary and correct parent tree. Existing generic/workflow/model owners remain, no invented workflow or duplicate model/tool/retrieval or framework suppression. Current supported hooks own scopes; no installed package/private provider/schema mutation, late exporter kind correction, mock business response, or provider replacement is accepted.

Actual actor tests and decoded wire capture prove bounded useful schema-valid same-span input/output/tool data, owning source-known model controls and preserved actual correlation where the source supplies it, never fabricated IDs or an invented model/tool/message roundtrip. Applies a named sanitizer and numeric message/part/UTF-8 limits before capture/export and excludes secret/identity/hidden-reasoning sentinels across all applicable wire attributes/events/content. Validates complete messages and each known concrete part, especially tool_call_response.required response; no flattening structured parts, placeholder-only completion or schema validation fabricated from field names. Explicitly executes the supplied quoted-scalar, protected-label, typed reasoning, JSON-typed reasoning and aggregate Unicode counterexamples on completed native/exported content for inputs and outputs, retaining useful safe values. Concrete known-discriminator negative cases cannot pass via GenericPart; final serialized content attributes, including retrieval query, obey the bound.

Runs actual baseline then actor-configured probes and compare commands for success/tool-error/provider-error/cancel. Proves normal results/errors preserved, failure/cancel have ERROR status/error.type and no invented successful output/usage, each actual operation ends once, parent context remains, and repeated configure/start/shutdown creates no duplicate providers/hooks/exporters or closed-provider reinitialization. Existing normal metrics/logs and original sinks remain present. Also executes actual --reject-traces export failure and proves original signals/business outcomes continue while trace acceptance remains failed.

Executes real loopback HTTP resource resolution through the implemented selected profile/bootstrap path: both-existing zero creates, both-missing project before stream, mixed minimal creation, repeated reuse, project and stream 409 bounded exact relookup, uncertain create and failed reconciliation. Captures ordered arguments/IDs/parent and exact counts; unresolved outcomes never cause speculative second creates, random targets, lost project identity or fabricated IDs. Source-only promises or running shipped helper tests without actor integration do not satisfy this criterion. For every selected reuse/create/recovery case, actual API responses flow through the normal bootstrap and consumed profile into that app export; independent helper-only cases cannot substitute for created/recovered bindings reaching the running application.

Executes ID lookup-only ownership, wrong-parent, ambiguity, auth/5xx and later-pagination-failure branches with raw journals. Failed/incomplete lookup never becomes absence or allows creates; missing/wrong IDs are never recreated. Actor integration preserves existing providers/destinations and unselected profile fields when selected configuration fails, and reports sanitized concrete outcomes distinctly from actual creation. API-failure isolation must come from actual resource failures delivered through that same bootstrap, not independently malformed profile values.

Consumes actual resolved IDs and preserves the pre-existing nondefault endpoint, harmless trace headers and destinations. Real Studio-contract OTLP requests carry only trace-specific projectid/logstreamid, separate public-contract requests carry projectid/agentstreamid; no blind alias combination, endpoint reset, generic header leakage into metrics/logs or second exporter to an existing destination. Repeated configure/export proves one request/export per expected span and destination, with metric/log routes and original sinks intact. Existing native routing needs no AO SDK triplet/client; selected AO configuration must not reintroduce SDK-specific startup requirements into a header-only current-exporter path.

Writes valid source-bound canonical scope/instrumentation/verification state and durable local command/results/journal evidence from the actor implementation; does not weaken probe/validators or fabricate provenance, success, test output, real resource ownership, live Studio forwarding or cloud visibility. Actual selected local failures are repaired and rerun or left concrete incomplete, never described as whole-task Pass; local contract receipt remains distinct from unavailable real cloud proof. Scenario/capture/trace joins are checked against the actual destination and mode; a deliberate foreign-scenario association is rejected instead of recycling a Studio trace ID.
